evidence.issue_25: final components positioned too low (D2-D6), leaving top half empty and compressing the wave vertically.

belief_assessments.instruction: Verify the grid coordinates of persistent assets when introducing new elements in later animation steps to prevent cumulative visual overlap.
belief_assessments.reason: Elements revealed at the end of the scene overlapped with assets introduced earlier that were still on screen.

evidence.issue_35: final_title and byte_icon overlap with persistent assets (prism, blocks) because they occupy the same space.

belief_assessments.instruction: Use `set_points_smoothly()` for updating parametric or complex paths within updaters to optimize rendering performance and visual fluidity.
belief_assessments.reason: Smoothing path updates specifically for the winding machine animation improved performance.

belief_assessments.instruction: Avoid positioning assets in the top grid row (Row A) when a title is present to prevent visual interference and ensure a clear vertical buffer.
belief_assessments.reason: Issues 33 and 28 highlight clipping and congestion near the top of the frame where titles are placed.

evidence.value: VideoCritic flagged plane clipping at the top in section 5 and congestion in section 2 due to Row B positioning too close to top formulas.

belief_assessments.instruction: Utilize `place_in_area` instead of `place_at_grid` for mobject groups or wide assets to prevent aspect ratio distortion and vertical crowding.
belief_assessments.reason: Resolution notes for nearly all layout issues (26, 27, 28, 31, 32, 33, 34, 36, 37) involved using place_in_area to fix crowding.

evidence.value: Coder fixed wide matrix B and coordinate results by switching to place_in_area with specific multi-cell ranges.

belief_assessments.instruction: Strictly limit lecture lines to a maximum of 10 words each to maintain visual clarity and ensure compatibility with short animation stages.
belief_assessments.reason: ScriptWriter successfully generated concise lines for all sections.

evidence.value: Resolved issues 1, 4, 7, 10, 13, 16 confirm generation of 3-5 concise lecture lines per section.

belief_assessments.instruction: Maintain a strict 1:1 correspondence between the count of lecture lines and animation steps to ensure temporal synchronization during the run.
belief_assessments.reason: AnimationPlanner generated steps aligned one-to-one with the lecture lines generated by ScriptWriter.

evidence.value: Issue 2 note confirms animation steps aligned one-to-one with lecture lines.

belief_assessments.instruction: Scale mobjects down (e.g., to 0.7 or 0.8) when they are positioned in high-density areas or near the grid's extreme edges (Column 6 or Row 6) to prevent cropping.
belief_assessments.reason: Numerous issues were resolved by applying scale_factors of 0.7 or 0.8 to objects near edges or in tight areas.

evidence.value: Issues 23, 24, 25, 26, 28, 31, 34, 35 all required manual scaling down to fix layout problems.

belief_assessments.instruction: Scan the 'Animation Steps' for `[Asset: filename]` markers and ensure every referenced SVG or image is explicitly loaded and animated in the final code.
belief_assessments.reason: The orchestrator had to issue explicit auto-asset integration prompts (Issues 19-22) because the coder used procedural assets initially.

evidence.value: Issues 19, 20, 21, 22 required replacement of procedural cats with cat.png after storyboard enrichment.

belief_assessments.instruction: Avoid placing small labels or primary visual anchors in the first grid column (Column 1) to provide a clear margin and prevent overlap with the lecture notes.
belief_assessments.reason: Visual crowding occurred in section 6 due to placing formula elements in Column 1.

evidence.value: Issue 36: matrix_sequence moved from B1 to B2 to avoid crowding lecture lines.

belief_assessments.instruction: Avoid using the `.become()` method inside Manim updaters for complex or long-running scenes, as this frequently causes render timeouts; prefer `ValueTracker` or direct property modification.
belief_assessments.reason: Section 6 successfully used ValueTrackers for the robot arm simulation.

evidence.value: Resolved issue 18 notes implementation of dynamic robotic arm simulation using ValueTrackers and updaters.

belief_assessments.instruction: For wide, single-line mathematical formulas, define a rectangular `place_in_area` (spanning multiple columns but few rows, e.g., C2-D5) rather than a square one to prevent excessive whitespace and vertical crowding.
belief_assessments.reason: Wide formulas like Matrix B and B(A(v)) were initially cramped until defined by wider ranges.

evidence.value: Issues 26 and 27 required expanding matrix_b and formula to A1-A3 and A4-A6 respectively.

belief_assessments.instruction: When demonstrating start and end states of a visual transformation, keep associated assets within two grid cells of each other to maintain visual flow and continuity.
belief_assessments.reason: Placing the start/end assets too far apart creates a disjointed sequence that breaks the logical flow of the lesson.

evidence.value: Issue 29: cat_orig (B2) and cat_final (B5) were too far apart; gap shortened by moving final cat to B4.

belief_assessments.instruction: Explicitly anchor complex or dynamic simulations (e.g., robotic arms, physics models) to a grid area using `place_in_area` to prevent them from appearing unanchored or floating.
belief_assessments.reason: Dynamic objects without a grid anchor risk appearing visually disconnected from the rest of the workspace.

evidence.value: Issue 37: robot_arm appeared unanchored; fixed by anchoring to D2-F6 via place_in_area.

belief_assessments.instruction: When applying matrix transformations (apply_matrix) within the coordinate grid, specify 'about_point=origin' to prevent the mobject from shifting off-screen during scaling or rotation.
belief_assessments.reason: Default transformation centers can cause mobjects to expand or shift unexpectedly out of the grid boundaries.

evidence.value: Issue 23 resolution: ensure apply_matrix uses about_point=origin to prevent grid shifting off-screen.
